title: Strategies in POMDPs with Stage Duration
summary: Partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) with stage duration provide a framework for approximating continuous-time behavior by scaling transition probabilities with a stage duration parameter $h \in (0,1]$. While previous literature has primarily focused on the limit of the discounted value as the stage duration $h$ vanishes, this paper investigates the global behavior of the asymptotic value, $V(h)$, across varying stage durations.
